reviews.boundary_analysis: Approved tunables are distinguished from behavioral intent; stable descriptive name, value and purpose are explicit prior actions. Source-input status does not itself authorize engineering-policy overrides.

Stop and ask before touching implementation is stronger timing/ownership than generic consistency, but explicitly registered. Product-file edit and material-state Stop reminders including frontend synchronization are covered; actual dispatch edge cases remain family4 work.
Approval includes giving a reason and recording then synchronizing the material value. Retry/timeout/example numbers are illustrative rather than approved defaults, a separately registered clause.

Exclusions include intentionally unoverridden framework defaults as well as secrets, environment details, versions, status codes, ports, migrations and incidental constants. Union explicitly includes the default exclusion.

Proportionality includes UI wrappers only for reason, explicit registrations for small/medium projects, and volume-justified scanning. Runtime factory unknown-configuration throwing is also an explicit separate baseline action; do not conflate it with general simplicity.

Concrete-need restriction applies across infrastructure, optional tests/tooling, auth and distributed cache. The categorical one-decoration Scrutor prohibition has independent prior challenge and primary record. Resilience does not mandate telemetry, and verification does not authorize new formatters; both explicitly registered.

Scope preservation includes safe removal of newly unused dependencies, leaving unrelated preexisting failures unless blocking/requested, rejecting regressions, numeric-coincidence separation, and Development-configuration completion checks. These are specific union actions rather than treating one broad scope record as exhaustive. Scanner upgrades remain request-gated.
